en.title: Named focus and pointer-only panels in Play views
en.body: A modal can select an opening control by name, including a target in a scrollable viewport. A view can request and read its native focus directly. Panels can keep pointer taps without taking keyboard or controller focus or exposing an activation through semantics.

zh.title: Play 视图的命名焦点和仅指针响应面板
zh.body: 模态视图可按名称指定打开时的焦点，包括可滚动视口中的目标。视图可直接请求和读取原生焦点。面板可只响应指针点击，不抢占键盘或手柄焦点，也不提供语义激活。
